title: Mirror transform over SAE feature space

amendment_1.reason: The first development implementation applied the frozen alpha=0.5 to compressed interventions but evaluated the explicit-FV reference at alpha=1.0. This amplitude mismatch invalidates that gate comparison. Preserve the initial run as a superseded diagnostic, and apply the same alpha to explicit FV and all intervention controls on rerun. No fresh examples were accessed and no configuration or data split changes.
amendment_1.supersedes: Initial development summary with unmatched explicit-FV scale; retained under runs/preflight_scale_mismatch/

hypothesis: On four held-out relation tasks in pinned Pythia-70m, a small orthogonal Givens View applied to sparse SAE feature activations can retain explicit-FV causal quality, keep post-transform activations sparse, and improve the quality/byte frontier over native SAE top-k, global sparse coding, and LoReFT at comparable intervention dimension.

task.type: pretrained causal-LM relation recall with residual-stream interventions
task.sae_shape: tied encoder [2048,512] with decoder atoms equal to encoder rows

physical_object: one pinned Pythia-70m and its shared 2048-atom layer-3 SAE
mirror_insertion: Apply a fixed sparse pairwise Givens transform to each sparse SAE activation vector before tied-decoder reconstruction; only angles and sparse activation codes vary by task.
mirror_coordinate: up to 16 FP16 Givens angles in a 32-dimensional active feature subspace; all transformed nonzeros, indices, angles, and metadata are charged.
mirror_angle_pattern: For scale s, shared angle theta_j=s*sin(2*pi*(j+1)/17), j=0..15. Pairwise rotate consecutive coordinates of the fit-selected 32-feature code bank. Apply to each task's SAE code, then retain the 8 largest absolute rotated coefficients and decode with original bank atoms. No held-out vector fits the shared angles.
feature_bank: Select the 32 SAE feature IDs with the largest aggregate positive encoder activations across fit task IDs 0-11 only. The untransformed shared-bank control uses top-eight absolute activations over this same bank.
controls: Native SAE encoder activations with top-eight positive features
Global-dictionary signed matching pursuit with eight atoms
Untransformed shared SAE sparse code with matched active dimension
Mirror Givens transform over the sparse feature code

split.fresh_open_rule: Open only after both dev seeds meet the quality, sparsity, and byte gates; freeze all transform and scale settings before opening. Fresh IDs and seeds are fixed here.

development.selection: No hyperparameter selection; evaluate one preregistered configuration for both development seeds.
development.selection_metric: dev gold-token log-probability, candidate accuracy, post-transform nonzeros, and actual serialized bytes; dev is a gate only

success_gate: On every fresh task and seed, mean gold-candidate log-probability must be within 0.10 nats and accuracy within 0.05 absolute of explicit FVs; Mirror must preserve <=16 nonzeros/task after code transform, use <=0.50x explicit incremental payload bytes, and not be dominated by either untransformed shared-bank sparse code or LoReFT at byte-near cost. Report standalone total bytes with the SAE charged.
failure_gate: Dev cannot satisfy the quality/sparsity/byte gates, or Mirror is dominated by native sparse coding or LoReFT at byte-near cost.
boundaries: Four relation tasks and one pinned model/layer only.
Fresh task IDs/seeds cannot tune settings.
Sparse activations and task-aligned function vectors do not establish broad behavior capacity.
